name: header
meaning: file header: Open reads 12 bytes straight over the object (header + count); no vptr

name: count
meaning: number of images in the pack (read at 0x49bc27)

name: file
meaning: open file handle (the CRT FILE * of fopen; fread/fseek/fclose take it)

name: opaqueValue
meaning: its address is passed at 0x55dc29; role not established
